items.title: Pay settlement amount (Vergleichsbetrag)
items.quote: Überweisen Sie den Vergleichsbetrag bis zum 01.12.2026 auf das Konto IBAN DE88 3704 0044 0532 0881 00, Kontoinhaber M. Beispielmann.
items.computation: The letter states a fixed calendar date for payment: 'bis zum 01.12.2026'. No statutory delivery-fiction applies because the sender is a private law firm, not a German authority, so the date printed is taken as written. 1 December 2026 is a Tuesday, not a weekend or public holiday in NRW, so no shift is required. To actually arrive by that date, a bank transfer should be sent about one business day earlier (§ 675s BGB), i.e. by 2026-11-30, but the due date itself (the date the money must be credited) is 2026-12-01.

warnings: The IBAN printed in the letter (DE88 3704 0044 0532 0881 00) fails the standard German IBAN checksum test — it may be misprinted or fake; do not pay without independently verifying the account details with the sending firm through a separately looked-up contact.

This is a private settlement demand (Abmahnung) from a law firm over alleged filesharing, not a court judgment or an authority's decision — there is no legal obligation to pay by the stated date, and such mass-mailed copyright Abmahnungen are a known pattern that sometimes involves inflated or unjustified claims; get independent legal advice (e.g. a Verbraucherzentrale or a specialist lawyer) before sending any money.

The letter urges a quick payment ('letzte außergerichtliche Gelegenheit') with the implied threat of a lawsuit — this pressure tactic is typical of both legitimate and fraudulent Abmahnungen and should not by itself be taken as proof the claim is valid.
